description: A painting of a snowy polar landscape under a dark, stormy sky with a bright sunrise glow on the horizon. An orange tracked vehicle with a truck cab, roof lamps and caterpillar treads pulls a canvas-covered sledge or trailer across the snow. Several figures in heavy fur-hooded parkas trek behind it, and a figure in the foreground leans on a long pole. No visible text, frame or wounds; the era cues (tracked tractor, canvas-covered load, fur clothing) suggest a mid-20th-century polar expedition.
